about.title: ABOUT US
about.description1: At Daga Media, we are passionate about visual narrative. From Boyacá to the world, we create content that inspires and connects.
about.description2: Specialized in 2D and 3D animation and high-impact cinematographic production.

animation2d.title: 2D Animation
animation2d.description: We create unique characters and worlds with traditional and digital techniques. Our stories come to life through fluid movement and captivating aesthetics.

animation3d.title: 3D Animation
animation3d.description: High-quality modeling, texturing and rendering. We take audiovisual production to the next level with visual effects and immersive three-dimensional environments.

tundama.title: Tundama
tundama.description: The story of a hero who defended his people with courage. An epic 3D animation production.
